comment: repo-policy — W7 repo-policy gate rows: policy as DATA (W1253 Amendment A: fleet config is JSON).
The engine (src/repo-policy.ts) runs these against the repo in view; rows are additive without code changes.
Resolution order: BUCKLE_REPO_POLICY env → runtime copy in ~/.claude/local-llm/ → this committed default.

Row grammar (v1): detect = all conditions must hold (absent = every repo); check = all must hold, first failure = one gap; conditions: {exists: p} {existsAny: [ps]} {grep: p, pattern} {grepAny: [ps], pattern} {httpGet: path, expect?, timeoutS?} (httpGet needs a caller-supplied base_url; unreachable = honest skip, never a false gap).

Laws: silent when satisfied — a satisfied row produces no prose, a gap produces exactly one actionable missingQuestion. Org-internal policy text NEVER commits: a row points at a LOCAL-ONLY coord fact via policySource: "fact:finding.ikea-<topic>".

rows.missingQuestion: the server entry registers no /health-style route — which liveness endpoint does this API serve?
no LICENSE file at the repo root — what license governs this code?
no CI config anywhere — where does CI for this repo live?
